messages:
Maria (ml): Quick benchmark dump: reranker + embed latency/throughput across GPUs and regions. TL;DR: CPU is fine for dims <= 768 at low QPS, but GPU is required for 1536/2048 and for sustained batching. EU has ~10% higher P95 vs us-west for same instance types; APAC shows sporadic cold-starts + kernel fallbacks. Posting commands, key numbers, and short recs below.

Akash (infra): Nice — do you have p50/p95 and QPS per instance? also which kernels/backends did you use?

Maria (ml): Setup: model=rerank-bert-1536 (embedding->rerank), quant=int8 (per-channel), backends tested: cuda (A100/T4), cpu (c6i), kernels compared: fused_attention (redwood-optimized) vs default cu_attention. Run command we used:```
./bench --model rerank-1536 --dim 1536 --batch 32 --backend cuda --kernel fused_attention --quant int8 --region eu-west-1
```

Liam (eng-ml): paste a tiny table pls — makes it easier to digest.

Maria (ml): small paste of representative numbers (p50/p95 latency in ms, QPS per instance) — these are medians across 3 runs, 60s windows:
```
GPU=A100 (p50/p95 / qps):
  dim=768  batch=8  12/18ms  /  420 qps
  dim=1536 batch=32 18/34ms  /  980 qps
  dim=2048 batch=32 30/68ms  /  520 qps
GPU=T4 (p50/p95 / qps):
  dim=768  batch=8  22/40ms  /  260 qps
  dim=1536 batch=32 44/96ms  /  420 qps
  dim=2048 batch=32 80/210ms /  180 qps
CPU=c6i.large (p50/p95 / qps):
  dim=768  batch=1  18/85ms  /  1200 qps
  dim=1536 batch=1  120/320ms /  120 qps
```
Note: EU runs on the same instance families showed ~10% higher p95 across the board; APAC runs had a ~20% higher p95 on T4 due to kernel fallback (see benchbot message).

Jen (sre): Observations: T4 wins cost/QPS at medium batch sizes for 1536, A100 wins latency headroom. For EU we should consider swapping to instances with local NVMe or different NICs — network jitter looks suspect.

Akash (infra): APAC latency spike — did you see any kernel fallback logs? that could explain the 20% regression.

benchbot: benchbot: anomaly detected in ap-southeast-1: fused_attention kernel unavailable on g4dn.xlarge, falling back to cu_attention. Log excerpt: `kernel_load: fused_attention -> FAIL (missing libjit_fused.so), fallback=cu_attention` (see: https://s3.internal/bench/logs/1772101234/fallback.log)

Maria (ml): Follow-up runs: CPU-only for dim=768 (batch=1) gives p95=85ms qps=1200 on c6i.large — pretty good for low-cost runs. For dim=1536 CPU p95=320ms qps=120 which is borderline. Recommendation: allow CPU routing only for dim<=768 and QPS < 1000, otherwise prefer GPU.

Liam (eng-ml): What about quality impact from quantization (int8)? any eval diffs?

Maria (ml): Quick eval on our devset (NDCG@10): FP16 baseline=0.813, INT8=0.808 -> delta -0.5% for 1536. For 2048 we saw FP16=0.821 vs INT8=0.810 -> delta -1.3% (so be cautious >1%). We also ran a small A/B on rerank ordering and saw very few flips for 1536-int8 (<0.6%).

Jen (sre): Action items: 1) pin kernel selection per region (prefer fused_attention where available), 2) add note in model-catalog: "cpu-eligible for dims<=768" and include performance table, 3) infra to investigate g4dn kernel packaging in ap-southeast-1 (INF-462).

Maria (ml): I'll upload raw CSVs + png latency charts to s3://redwood-bench/1772101234/ and add a short README with commands and eval artifacts. cc @Akash (infra) @Jen (sre)

Akash (infra): :thumbsup: assigning INF-462 to infra team. Thanks Maria — this is actionable.
